child_reaction: But what if I miss you?
You were looking right at the door, not at the window.
They didn't even try to pick me.
It hurts really bad, can you see?
Okay. But will you see tomorrow?
No! Busy or not, it doesn't matter!
But what if it's not dead, what if it comes after me?
But what if it's something bad?
Fine, but you'll see it later.
The one with the sun and the sky and the trees.
But it's huge, I'm telling you.
Not a second? That's a stupid joke.
Can I show you the paper?
Can I watch TV while we wait?
We were playing together and then he just went home.
It hurts a lot. Can you fix it?
No. Just told him I didn't want to play that part in the show.
Can I watch from the window?
But it wasn't even close, it happened way before.
But can you at least listen?
But they can hurt me, what if they're right behind me?
Can you talk to me on the phone too?
The red one. You mean a lot.
Okay. Can you watch me when you're in the bathroom?
See? I told you I could.
Can I show you the paper?
But it hurts! Can you look?
But we never talk on calls.
It was mostly me and this one kid, we kept playing until the bell rang.
Can I at least watch TV?
But I couldn't even see it!
That's too early, can we watch tomorrow?
Can you wait just a minute?
Can I just sit for a second?
Can you look at the calendar with me?
But it's not fair, she never told me it was bad.
Okay. But you'll be awake soon?
It's just dark in there though.
Yes but no one else gets to choose
(makes a disappointed sound and gets quieter)
It really really really hurts, can you make it stop?
But I'm lonely and I don't want it.
But what if it wakes Mia?
Can we at least look together?
No! Neither! They didn't even ask me!
It hurts a lot and I think it's going to leave a scar.
But it was just one point!
That. And Jen said no too.
But it's not fair, you never let me look!
You don't have to get me anything.
No! Don't hang up, talk to me first.
Can you help me feel better?
It hurts. Can I have a bandage?
Can you look at it with me?
Can I show you the whole test?
It hurts and I think I need a bandage.
But I'll be quiet, I promise.
But can I show you first?
But I'll be quick, I promise.
But he started it, tell him too.
No. Can you sleep here until morning?
Fine, stay on the phone then!
Maybe it was just the dog.
Did you see? Did you come look?
But what if it comes out?
No, can I lie in bed for a little bit?
But what if he doesn't talk?
I won't break it, and I'm not even touching it.
Okay. Can I watch until eight?
